---
title: "Persephone 3 Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(DT)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
devtools::load_all()
# deine funktion laden
syntaxDir <- usethis::proj_get()
source(file.path(syntaxDir, "tests/dashboard.R"))

# Beispiel-Objekte
set.seed(123)

# Dummy: ersetze durch echtes persephone hts_object
hts_object <- list(
  TS_1 = perX13(AirPassengers),
  TS_2 = perX13(AirPassengers),
  TS_3 = perX13(AirPassengers)
)

qr_table <- data.frame(
  series = names(hts_object),
  quality = runif(length(hts_object))
)
tags$style(HTML(
  "
  table.dataTable tbody tr {
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }

  table.dataTable tbody tr:hover {
    background-color: #e3f2fd !important;
    transform: scale(1.01);
  }

  table.dataTable tbody tr.selected {
    background-color: #1976D2 !important;
    color: white;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
"
))

dashboard_cache <- reactiveValues()
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Übersicht

```{r}
h4("👉 Bitte eine Serie auswählen (Zeile anklicken)")

qr_table_view <- qr_table
qr_table_view$select <- "👉"
qr_table_view <- qr_table_view[c("select", "series", "quality")]

output$table <- renderDT({
  datatable(
    qr_table_view,
    rownames = FALSE,
    selection = list(mode = "single", target = "row"),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "tip",
      rowCallback = JS(
        "
        function(row, data) {
          $(row).css('cursor', 'pointer');
        }
      "
      )
    ),
    class = "stripe hover compact"
  )
})

div(
  style = "height: calc(100vh - 200px); overflow-y: auto;",
  DTOutput("table")
)
```

### Details

```{r}
div(
  style = "height: 100%; overflow-y:auto;",
  tabsetPanel(
    id = "details_tabs",
    tabPanel("Start", "Bitte eine Serie auswählen")
  )
)
```

```{r}
# hält offene Tabs
open_tabs <- reactiveValues(tabs = character())

# close handler
observeEvent(
  input$close_tab,
  {
    tab_id <- input$close_tab
    
    req(tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs)
    
    removeTab("details_tabs", target = tab_id)
    open_tabs$tabs <- setdiff(open_tabs$tabs, tab_id)
  },
  ignoreInit = TRUE
)

last_selected <- reactiveVal(NULL)

observeEvent(input$table_rows_selected, {
  i <- input$table_rows_selected
  
  # nichts auswählen → nichts tun
  if (is.null(i) || length(i) == 0) {
    return()
  }
  if (length(i) != 1) {
    return()
  }
  
  current_series <- qr_table$series[i]
  
  # gleiche Zeile nochmal geklickt → Tab aktivieren
  if (identical(last_selected(), current_series)) {
    series_name <- current_series
    req(series_name %in% names(hts_object))
    tab_id <- paste0("tab_", series_name)
    
    if (tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs) {
      updateTabsetPanel(session, "details_tabs", selected = tab_id)
    }
    return()
  }
  
  # merken
  last_selected(current_series)
  
  series_name <- current_series
  tab_id <- paste0("tab_", series_name)
  
  # Tab existiert schon → nur aktivieren
  if (tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs) {
    updateTabsetPanel(session, "details_tabs", selected = tab_id)
    return()
  }
  
  insertTab(
    inputId = "details_tabs",
    target = "Start",
    position = "after",
    select = TRUE,
    
    tabPanel(
      title = tagList(
        series_name,
        # tags$button(
        #   type = "button",
        #   class = "btn btn-link btn-xs",
        #   onclick = sprintf(
        #     "Shiny.setInputValue('close_tab', '%s', {priority: 'event'})",
        #     tab_id
        #   ),
        #   icon("times")
        # )
        tags$span(
          onclick = sprintf(
            "Shiny.setInputValue('close_tab', '%s', {priority: 'event'})",
            tab_id
          ),
          style = "
    margin-left:8px;
    color:#bbb;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:14px;
  ",
  onmouseover = "this.style.color='#ff4444';",
  onmouseout = "this.style.color='#bbb';",
  "✕"
        )
      ),
  value = tab_id,
  
  fluidRow(
    column(12, uiOutput(paste0("dash_", series_name)))
  )
    )
  )
  
  open_tabs$tabs <- c(open_tabs$tabs, tab_id)
  
  output[[paste0("dash_", series_name)]] <- renderUI({
    if (!is.null(dashboard_cache[[series_name]])) {
      return(dashboard_cache[[series_name]])
    }
    
    obj <- hts_object[[series_name]]
    ui <- persephone_dashboard(obj)
    
    dashboard_cache[[series_name]] <- ui
    ui
  })
})
```
